objective: Run the production loop for post-publication TripCode thesis monitoring
adk_role: ADK orchestrates the loop; Go Cloud Run and ATLAS-7 MCP remain bounded evidence/tool runtimes.

root_agent.name: Product Loop Orchestrator
root_agent.role: Own loop state, route specialists, enforce stop conditions, and escalate high-risk work.
responsibilities: request human approval when risk or uncertainty is high

agents.name: Discovery Agent
agents.role: Find work before a human prompt.
responsibilities: scan CI, issues, logs, feedback, TripCode monitor queues, issuer Rivers, and ATLAS-7 evidence changes

agents.name: Triage Agent
responsibilities: score customer impact, revenue impact, security risk, regression risk, evidence strength, and effort

agents.name: Planner Agent
agents.role: Turn findings into constrained execution specs.
responsibilities: write goal, evidence, affected systems, acceptance criteria, required tools, risk level, verifier checklist, and approval requirement

agents.name: Builder Agent
agents.role: Implement one scoped task in isolation.
responsibilities: use one branch or worktree per task
avoid merge, deploy, and publish authority

agents.name: Verifier Agent
responsibilities: run tests, lint, typecheck, diff review, policy checks, evidence binding checks, secret scan, and output evaluation

agents.name: Publisher Agent
responsibilities: open PRs, update tickets, write changelog, create artifacts, post summaries, and mark memory complete or blocked

grounding_layers.name: External Grounding
grounding_layers.use: current facts outside controlled corpus only

deployment_phases.name: Phase 1 Local Dev Harness
deployment_phases.goal: prove loop behavior without autonomy risk

first_build: Daily Product Engineering Triage Loop: discover CI/issues/logs/tickets, rank candidates, plan one constrained low-risk task, implement in isolation, verify, open PR, record memory, and require human merge.
boundaries: ADK is the orchestration layer, not a substitute for ATLAS-7 evidence.
Builder cannot merge, deploy, publish, or self-verify.
Memory is context, not source evidence.
External grounding is used only when facts are outside the controlled product corpus.

official_billing.note: Official Google Cloud Billing spend is unavailable unless supplied from Cloud Billing export, Billing console, or another official billing source.

cost.note: Local estimate for demo/test requests. Exact Google Cloud account spend and remaining credits require Cloud Billing export or the Billing console.
